name: Die Krummerei
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Krummerei in Söll**

Discover the cozy charm of **Söll** with a visit to the **Krummerei**, a traditional inn nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** countryside. Here, you’ll savor authentic **Tiroler** hospitality and hearty local dishes, from crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** to rich **Käsespätzle**. The rustic ambiance and warm service make it the perfect spot to unwind after a day of hiking or skiing in the stunning **Zillertal** Alps.

Whether you’re craving a hearty meal or just a relaxing break, the **Krummerei** promises an unforgettable experience in one of **Tirol’s** most picturesque villages.
